name: Mara's Capacity Caching
hypothesis: Previous attempts failed because mandatory deposit rules triggered immediately after gathering a single item (cargo=1), preventing full capacity utilization and causing agents to carry less than their maximum load. This led to excessive travel distance per trip relative to food gained, effectively nullifying the benefit of fixed rest intervals. By changing the 'carrying' condition from cargo>=0 to cargo>0 but delaying the first mandatory deposit until the agent has harvested enough items to be nearly full (specifically, requiring 2 items before the first forced deposit), agents will maximize food per movement cycle and increase total stored food within 720 steps.
